structured_output.what_is_happening: This is ESwAE…2SY, a "Super Intelligence" (SI) token. It is one of at least 10 SI copycats that appeared after Trump said at the UN on 2026-09-22 that AI would be renamed "super intelligence". It was not launched on pump.fun (no -pump address, launchpad null). Its PumpSwap pool was created 17 seconds after the token was minted. The pool is funded with about $179k of liquidity that is not locked, which is more than the $104k market cap. In 36 minutes it printed $6.6M of volume (37x turnover of the market cap) from 922 unique buyers but only 40 unique sellers. GMGN flags 144 bundler wallets. I found no social presence of its own. The community link points to a generic X community, there is no website, and searching the contract address returned nothing.

narrative.description: Trump's UNGA speech renaming AI 'super intelligence' (real, widely covered on 2026-09-22 by The Hill, WaPo, Fox and CNBC). It has already spawned a Solana meme leader, Super Inu (SI, DEW9…), which reached $6-10M mcap according to KuCoin news flashes.
narrative.why_spreading: A presidential quote plus viral mockery ('The View' etc.) is a strong meme hook. But the event is now 2 days old, and the attention has already settled on Super Inu and a pump.fun SI (82ez…pump, about $700k).

token_connection.why_this_token: None beyond sharing the name. It is a late copy launched about 2 days after the event, with no socials, no profile, and no mentions found for the contract address.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Super Inu DEW9… ($6.2M mcap, the one news covers). 82ezhRL…pump 'Super Intelligence' ($711k). 9LUf…pump ($577k). Plus about 7 more SI clones.

authenticity.evidence: 922 unique buyers against 40 unique sellers, yet 3,361 sells: a few wallets are making most of the sells, which looks like wash/volume bots. $6.6M of volume on a $104k mcap. GMGN tags 144 bundler wallets. The creator made its own PumpSwap pool 17 seconds after minting, with liquidity above the market cap and LP 0% locked/burned. RugCheck flags 'Large Amount of LP Unlocked' and 'Low amount of LP Providers'. There are no organic mentions.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count could include some real retail drawn in by volume/trending. I could not see X posts directly.

structural_risks: The creator-supplied PumpSwap LP is unlocked (lp_burn_ratio 0), so about $179k can be pulled at any time
Fake-looking volume: 40 unique sellers against 3.4k sells
It sits under a much larger canonical SI token that already holds the narrative's attention
86% of supply is in the pool, so the price moves only through the pool the creator controls

structured_output.counterargument: The narrative is real and loud, and SI clones are drawing buyers. A $104k coin with $179k of liquidity and 900+ buyers could get swept up by retail rotating out of Super Inu toward 'cheaper SI' and double to about $200k. Holder distribution looks spread out (top 10 below 10%), and the price is up 60% in the hour.

source_coverage.notes: News confirms the Trump 'super intelligence' event and the Super Inu leader. Searching the contract address gave zero results. The project has no website or telegram, and its socials are only a generic X community link.

structured_output.thesis: A late, non-canonical clone on a 2-day-old narrative. The pool is creator-built with unlocked LP bigger than the market cap, the volume looks wash-traded (40 sellers), and 144 bundler wallets are present. It looks like a volume-farm or liquidity-pull setup, not organic discovery. Doubling is unlikely, and a rug is likely.
